name: @clara/web
description: Clara web app (P1 foundation scaffold). Next.js App Router, deployed to Cloudflare Workers via @opennextjs/cloudflare; replaces apps/dashboard at cutover. See README.md for the rulings pointer and token provenance.

scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-token-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-test-manifest.mjs && node scripts/check-test-manifest.selftest.mjs
scripts.cf:preview: node scripts/check-public-key.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/check-public-key.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
